description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class StaffRoleException used in the Fineract project. It extends AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException and relates to staff role validation within the organization module.

classes.name: StaffRoleException
classes.description: A custom runtime exception indicating that a staff resource with a given role or ID is invalid or not found.

methods.name: StaffRoleException
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception message indicating an invalid role for a staff member with a specific ID.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Overrides the default toString to return the role name in lowercase with hyphens replaced by spaces.

calls: super(String message, String defaultUserMessage, Object... args)
